arxiv-2302-01729.title: Resolving Left-Right Ambiguity During Bearing Only Tracking of an Underwater Target Using Towed Array
arxiv-2302-01729.creator: Shreya Das, Ranjeet Kumar Tiwari, Shovan Bhaumik
arxiv-2302-01729.description: Abstract In bearing only tracking using a towed array, the array can sense the bearing angle of the target but is unable to differentiate whether the target is on the left or the right side of the array. Thus, the traditional tracking algorithm generates tracks in both the sides of the array which create difficulties when interception is required.

arxiv-2305-18162.title: Diffusion enhancement and Taylor dispersion for rotationally symmetric flows in discs and pipes
arxiv-2305-18162.creator: Michele Coti Zelati, Michele Dolce, Chia-Chun Lo
arxiv-2305-18162.description: Abstract . In this note, we study the long-time dynamics of passive scalars driven by rotationally symmetric flows. We focus on identifying precise conditions on the velocity field in order to prove enhanced dissipation and Taylor dispersion in three-dimensional infinite pipes.

arxiv-2309-12670.title: weak degeneracy of regular graphs
arxiv-2309-12670.creator: Yuxuan Yang
arxiv-2309-12670.description: Abstract . Motivated by the study of greedy algorithms for graph coloring, Bernshteyn and Lee introduced a generalization of graph degeneracy, which is called weak degeneracy. In this paper, we show the lower bound of the weak degeneracy for d d -regular graphs is exactly ⌊ d / 2 ⌋ + 1 \lfloor d/2\rfloor+1 , which is tight.

arxiv-2311-08119.title: Hamming distance as a measure of spatial chaos in evolutionary games
arxiv-2311-08119.creator: Gaspar Alfaro, Miguel A.F. Sanjuán
arxiv-2311-08119.description: Abstract From a context of evolutionary dynamics, social games can be studied as complex systems that may converge to a Nash equilibrium. Nonetheless, they can behave in an unpredictable manner when looking at the spatial patterns formed by the agents’ strategies. This is known in the literature as spatial chaos.

arxiv-2403-20313.title: Towards a turnkey approach to unbiased Monte Carlo estimation of smooth functions of expectations
arxiv-2403-20313.creator: Nicolas Chopin, Francesca R. Crucinio, Sumeetpal S. Singh
arxiv-2403-20313.description: Abstract . Given a smooth function f f , we develop a general approach to turn Monte Carlo samples with expectation m m into an unbiased estimate of f ⁡ ( m ) f(m) . Specifically, we develop estimators that are based on randomly truncating the Taylor series expansion of f f and estimating the coefficients of the truncated series.

arxiv-2502-03552.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Haritha Ananthakrishnan, Julian Dolby, Harsha Kokel, Horst Samulowitz, Kavitha Srinivas. Cross encoders (CEs) are trained with sentence pairs to detect relatedness. As CEs require sentence pairs at inference, the prevailing view is that they can only be used as re-rankers in information retrieval pipelines.

pmc-12811068.title: Relapsing Blastic Plasmacytoid Dendritic Cell Neoplasm With Neurologic Involvement
pmc-12811068.creator: Zehra Rahman, Austin Haley, Shirley Gandhi, Abdullah Mohamed, Kevin Parza, JR Quan
pmc-12811068.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm (BPDCN) is a rare and aggressive hematologic malignancy characterized by cutaneous, bone marrow, and central nervous system (CNS) involvement. Despite advances in therapy, prognosis remains poor, particularly in relapsed or refractory disease. We present the case of a woman in her 30s with a history of BPDCN diagnosed three months prior at an outside hospital following symptoms of blurry vision, headaches, night sweats, and weight loss.
